summary: Formats a temperature for display. Converts the input Kelvin value a2 to Celsius (v5 = a2 - 273.16); when the unit-mode flag this[1] equals 1 the value is additionally converted to Fahrenheit ((v5 - -40.0) * 1.8 - 40.0) and the Fahrenheit unit-string pointer (byte_5C3738) is selected, otherwise the Celsius unit-string pointer (byte_5C3734) is used. The integer temperature and unit string are then formatted with the "%d %s" template via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck into the destination buffer a3. Called by MenuCommandDispatcher (004674e0).

local_names.this: object holding the unit-mode flag at this[1]
local_names.a3: destination buffer for the formatted string
local_names.v5: temperature converted to the display unit (Celsius, or Fahrenheit when the flag is set)

operations.description: Converts Kelvin to Celsius: v5 = a2 - 273.16

Calls StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck with the destination buffer a3, the "%d %s" template, the integer temperature and the selected unit string
Returns the result of the string formatting call
